text: Harness installed on cloud branch; commit harness/memory/memory.jsonl before session end or lessons are lost.

Removed 2 uncited hardware refs (Loihi/SpiNNaker) for IEEE compliance and scope; signposted existing Limitations paragraph; trimmed keywords 8->6. Citation integrity clean (23/23). papercheck submission: 2 errors -> 1 (only abstract length 274>200 remains).

Added Ethics statement: secondary analysis of de-identified data collected by Stony Brook Univ. Lab for Clinical Affective Neuroscience under its IRB; authors did no new collection. Mirrors DEAP handling. Clears papercheck ethics.statement flag. No IRB number fabricated.

CFP confirmed: IEEE BIBM 2026 Doctoral Forum is SINGLE-blind (author names required, no anonymized twin needed); 6-page limit EXCLUDING references and appendices; 1-page first-author CV appendix required. Set papercheck venue.blinding=single. Committed PDF: main=7pp incl refs, with_cv=8pp. CV appendix is real (A. Lane).
Tightened abstract 274->253 words, all 10 numeric tokens preserved. Remaining abstract.length flag is the tool's 200-word default; BIBM CFP sets no abstract limit, so it is non-blocking cosmetic.

No with-CV source existed; main_bibm2026_with_cv.pdf was a manual PDF merge of paper+CV (different doc classes). Committed PDFs are stale after source edits. Added main_bibm2026_with_cv.tex (pdfpages wrapper) and BUILD.md so the combined submission PDF is reproducible: build paper, build CV, then build wrapper.

Built submission PDFs from current source with pdflatex (installed via HTTPS apt mirrors). Clean compile: 0 undefined refs/citations, 0 overfull boxes. Paper body ends p6 (Ethics/Data Avail on p6), references tail to p7 -> body within 6-page limit (refs excluded). main_bibm2026_with_cv.pdf = 8pp (6 body + 1 ref + 1 CV), contains ethics statement + CV. This is the submission file.

Per author preference: replaced 'audit' (5 prose uses) with 'characterize/characterization' (matches conference title theme; left figure filename fig_pipeline_bsc6_audit.png). Removed all 30 em-dashes (---), replaced with parentheses/commas/colons per grammar; left en-dashes (numeric ranges, structure--function). Recompiled clean: 0 undefined, 0 overfull, body within 6pp.

Author revised Ethics statement to name the SHAPE study and drop the secondary-analysis/de-identified qualifiers: 'The SHAPE study was collected by the Stony Brook University Laboratory for Clinical Affective Neuroscience under that laboratory's IRB oversight. DEAP is public [koelstra2012deap].' Kept the \textbf{Ethics.} label; papercheck ethics check still PASS; body within 6pp.

Data Availability revised to point to SHAPE dataset contact (Laboratory for Clinical Affective Neuroscience, Stony Brook, lab-can.com) + DEAP public. Dropped prior 'access-controlled/aggregate-only' and 'clinical labels not diagnostic' sentences per author. Clean compile; body within 6pp.

Named the primary dataset throughout: 'Stress, Health, and the Psychophysiology of Emotion (SHAPE) project' at first mention in methods with lab pointer (Laboratory for Clinical Affective Neuroscience, Stony Brook, lab-can.com); 'our cohort'/'primary cohort' -> SHAPE in fig caption, DEAP section, limitations. Author confirmed the 'clinical labels not diagnostic' disclaimer is unnecessary (engineering paper) - kept removed. Clean compile, body within 6pp.

Converted SHAPE lab pointer from inline \url in body to a proper numbered reference [24] (\bibitem{shape}: Laboratory for Clinical Affective Neuroscience, SHAPE project, Stony Brook; URL in the reference only, like DEAP). Cited in methods + Data Availability. Citation integrity 24/24 clean.

Final human-voice pass: varied intro verb (characterize->compare) to avoid echoing the abstract, replaced stilted 'namely'+colon in intro, and merged a clunky double-parenthesis in contribution 2. Numbers preserved, clean compile, body within 6pp. Bundle = main_bibm2026_with_cv.pdf (8pp).

Adopted author's humanized revision as main_bibm2026.tex. Verified against prior version: identical numeric value-set (no value changed/added/removed; only benign count shifts from abstract simplification), 0 em-dashes, 0 forbidden claims (only 'Perturbation Diagnostics' title and Maass 'Real-time computing' ref title), clean compile 7pp (body 6pp, refs p7), 24/24 citations. Reads more human: shorter sentences, measured tone, 'reservoir not a proposed winner'; ranking described as 'changes' (more accurate than 'reverses'). Rebuilt bundle 8pp.

Title -> 'Spiking Reservoir Encoding of Affective EEG: Perturbations and Invariances' (no ARSPI-Net in title; BIBM colon form; physics register). Learned ARSPI-Net from parent repo (operational-distinctness-paper): Affective Reservoir-Spike Processing and Inference Network, reservoir-graph framework with E/D/T/C streams; this paper is the E/spike-embedding slice (~30%). Added bounded intro positioning naming ARSPI-Net as parent framework (acronym expanded, graph/coupling/closed-loop scoped out). Dropped all body 'characterization' wording. Clean compile, numbers intact, body 6pp.

AUTHOR WORDING RULES (title + prose) — BANNED words: 'observable', 'characterization'/'characterize', 'audit', 'behavior', 'robustness' (in title), 'response', 'metric'. PREFERRED physics/dynamical-systems register: perturbations, invariances, state-space, edge of stability, spiking reservoir, neuromorphic. Do not reintroduce banned words. FINAL TITLE: 'On the Edge of Stability: Spiking-Reservoir State-Space Encoding of Affective EEG'.
S60204 camera-ready: author keeps the title 'On the Edge of Stability' (no retitle). E1 rho sweep must supply the evidence; claims limited to what E1 shows.

Camera-ready code audit (docs/CODE_AUDIT.md): paper Eq.2-3 corrected to the code's LIF update ((1-beta) leak, reset factor, rectification); band power recomputed from X_ds with the documented Welch estimator everywhere (pickle conv_feats not reproducible from X_ds); train-only PCA in all main analyses; one signal-level perturbation protocol for all encoders (scripts/perturbations.py); every paper number now from committed scripts.

Harness verify_latex.py ran latexmk with cwd=tex dir but passed the caller-relative path, so manuscripts in subdirectories never built (harness fixture good_latex_build failed). Fixed locally; upstream myResearchAssitantHarness still needs the fix.
Author wording rules (#16) were silently violated by later edits; analysis/check_author_wording.py now enforces them on title+prose+captions (not bibliography). Run it before every commit.
Peer-review content stays out of git while the repo is public: reviewer memory entries live in submission/reviewer_memory.jsonl and the response plan in submission/rebuttal.md, both git-ignored.

Camera-ready claim restated after E2 (train-only PCA): zero-fill ERP-window minus reservoir at 30% is +0.049 [+0.003,+0.095], so it is no longer 'within noise'; in-distribution fills give +0.092 to +0.107. The paper now says zero-fill halves the ERP-window lead (abstract, V-B, Discussion, Conclusion). Mean-zero gaps follow measured non-centeredness |mu|/sigma (band-power 1.20 > ERP-window 0.75 > reservoir 0.06).

For band-power and ERP-window, signal-level electrode removal equals zero-fill of the feature block exactly (a flat trace has zero band power and zero window means); E4 removal rows reproduce E2 zero-fill values to 4 decimals. Use this as a consistency check whenever either experiment changes.

Table numbers in docs drifted from the compiled PDF (docs said Table III/IV; the paper has Tables I-III). Take table and figure numbers from the compiled PDF, never from memory or the reviewed version.

Page limit (6 pages excluding references) met by redrawing Fig. 1 and Fig. 2 as single rows across both columns and sizing Figs. 3-4 for one column at print size (fonts >= 5.5 pt printed), plus removing repeated definitions; no result was dropped.
Title hyphen dropped to match the BIBM portal record exactly: 'On the Edge of Stability: Spiking Reservoir State-Space Encoding of Affective EEG' (author decision, camera-ready).

Epoch timing verified: X_ds == raw[0:1024:4] of 1229-sample 1024 Hz epochs, onset at raw sample 205 (baseline mean exactly 0), so X_ds spans -200..+800 ms with onset at sample 51 and per-epoch z-scoring. All window labels must be stated relative to onset; the code's ERP_WINDOWS_MS are sample-index ms from epoch start.

Camera-ready accuracy review: reference lists need source verification too — banville2022dsf carried another paper's JNE volume/article number (correct: NeuroImage 251:118994, 2022). Check every bibitem against Crossref/arXiv before submission, not only the ones added last.

Order-parameter text now states the ten-step settling interval and 400 sampled drives; rho* = 0.82 by interpolation; the rho=0 cost is reported with its CI [-0.098,-0.002] in the abstract and noted as within noise under 30% removal; EEGNet augmentation claim scoped to 'for this architecture'. Camera-ready body ends on page 6 after prose trims.
